1.title: 1,000 days of Duolingo didn't work. So he built his own app with Codex.
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Solo founder built a voice learning app (Mural) using Codex and GPT-Live without knowing Swift; covers design prompts, real latency/cost numbers for voice AI, and how he uses a Lord of the Rings-themed agent system (Grok Bot) to delegate founder roles across 15 open tabs.

2.title: Did Anthropic Cross Its RSI Warning Line? | Parv Mahajan
2.author: MTS
2.hook: METR's analysis of Anthropic's R&D acceleration — 2x sustained since late 2025, why public models mask the actual pace, absence of near-term compute bottlenecks, and evidence Anthropic crossed its own internal warning threshold for acceleration.

1.title: I Tested Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5 on 5 Real Use Cases
1.author: Peter Yang
1.hook: Direct model comparison (Fable 5.2 vs Claude Opus 3.5) across 5 concrete tasks: 3D code generation (travel video, racing game), website redesign, essay writing, and adversarial pushback. Shows prompts and outputs for each. Includes pattern for reducing AI slop in system prompts.

2.title: Any Good Brand is a Cult
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Alyssa Bonanno (Better Half) on how consumer brands function as secular religions with mythology and ritual; case studies from Polymarket, Equinox, and Bryan Johnson campaigns; discussion of algorithmic feeds and information culture.
